mux.js
https://github.com/videojs/mux.js

Scia's engine includes mux.js, bundled in its code, to put the pieces of an HLS stream back into
one mp4 without re-encoding them (docs/adr/0010-a-stream-made-into-an-mp4-inside-scia.md in
Scia's repository). Its version is fixed in apps/server/package.json.

mux.js is released under the Apache License, version 2.0, whose text is in LICENSE.txt beside
this file.
